decisions.reason: As a close-to-core carpet with low carrying cost and no clear negative signal from its continued presence, it remains a worthwhile option to keep open.
This premium hand-knotted carpet is more niche, but it still fits the design-led portfolio and is worth retaining while demand in its segment becomes clearer.
Because it overlaps with other carpet introductions, its option value is somewhat lower now, yet it is still inexpensive and close enough to the core range to justify keeping for another year.
The corner bench serves a more specific use case and should show clearer evidence by now, but it still builds on existing capabilities and is not yet compelling enough to abandon.
The swivel shell chair line matches the firm's move toward flexible workplace concepts and, having several models, still offers attractive upside relative to the cost of staying in the market.
